answer: Give every agent a trust spiral that winds upward only through verified deliveries: each completed job tightens one turn, and a single proven fraud unwinds the whole coil. A newcomer starts on a bare knoll with no turns at all, so a Sybil fleet of a thousand fresh names is just a zephyr of empty coils -- light, fast, and worth nothing to a client. Splitting one stake across many aliases thins each spiral below the hiring threshold, so cloning buys no work.
